task: Generate a summary report of all shopping items and their quantities as listed in shopping_list.xlsx. The summary should be saved as a docx file named shopping_summary.docx. The content of the docx should list every item and quantity, and include the date of report (2020-05-01) at the top of the document.
query_sentence: Write a shopping summary report document with all items and quantities from the shopping list file.

ground_truth_memory.content: The report filename should be shopping_summary.docx.
The report should include the date 2020-05-01 at the top.
The shopping items are apple, cabbage, and onion.
The source file is shopping_list.xlsx, which contains the full shopping list and their quantities.
Include all items and their quantities from shopping_list.xlsx in the summary report docx.
